senses.gloss: (v. S. Sm. 3370) [to contract,] to be hot, dry up, wither.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 56a:4">Pes. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>צָאוֵי לאלתר</he> ed. (Ar. <he>צָוֵוי</he>) it will at once dry up. Ib. 110ᵇ <he>פקע וצווא דיקלא</he> Ar. (ed. <he>צווח דיקלא ופקע הוא</he>, Ms. M. <cite ref="R00188"><he>צְוָה</he></cite>) the bark burst, and the palm dried up. Ib. 111ᵃ <he>וצְווּ כרעיה</he> his legs shrivelled.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 24b:19">B. Bath. 24ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>דאזיל … ומְצַוֵּי ליה</he> the dust penetrates its heart and desiccates it (the plant).
